about: Invented jobs for calibrating the scoring rubrics (agent/scoring-rubric.md, DEC-067). Every company is made up. Each job names the sample profile it is scored against and the label it should get.

icu-nurse.summary: ICU nurse at a community hospital; wants a senior staff or charge nurse role in a larger ICU.

staff-accountant.summary: Staff accountant in public accounting for four years; wants a senior accountant role in industry.

backend-developer.summary: Backend developer building APIs and data pipelines; wants a senior backend role at a product company.
backend-developer.workAuthorization: US and Canadian citizen, no sponsorship needed
dealBreakers: on-call more than one week a month

jobs.title: ICU Registered Nurse - Day Shift
jobs.description:
Join our 24-bed Level II ICU. Three 12-hour day shifts a week. Care for ventilated and post-surgical patients, titrate drips, respond to rapid responses.

Required: Texas or compact RN license, BLS and ACLS, 3+ years of ICU experience.
Preferred: CCRN, experience precepting new graduates.

jobs.title: Critical Care Travel Nurse (13-week contract)
jobs.description:
13-week travel nursing contract in a busy medical ICU, with extension possible. Day and night rotation.

Required: active RN license, BLS, ACLS, 2+ years of ICU experience.

jobs.title: Nurse Manager, Cardiac ICU
jobs.description:
Lead a 60-person cardiac ICU team: staffing, budgets, quality measures and hiring. Some weekend on-call.

Required: Texas RN license, MSN, 5+ years of critical care with 3+ years in a formal leadership role.

jobs.title: Senior Accountant
jobs.description:
Own the month-end close for two business units: journal entries, account reconciliations and flux analysis under US GAAP. Support the annual audit.

Required: 3-5 years of accounting experience, NetSuite or a similar ERP, advanced Excel.
Preferred: CPA.
Hybrid: three days a week in our Chicago office.

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Specialist
jobs.description:
Process vendor invoices and payment runs, keep vendor records, and help with reconciliations at month-end.

Required: 1-2 years of accounts payable experience, Excel.
Fully remote within the United States.

jobs.title: Payroll Accountant
jobs.description:
Run multi-state payroll for 3,000 employees, reconcile payroll accounts and file payroll tax returns.

Required: Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) certification, 4+ years of multi-state payroll experience, ADP Workforce Now.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer (Go)
jobs.description:
Build the Go services behind our shipment tracking API. Design REST endpoints, tune PostgreSQL, run everything on Kubernetes.

Required: 5+ years of backend development, Go, PostgreSQL.
Nice to have: Kafka, AWS.
Remote anywhere in the US; on-call one week in six.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer, Ads Platform
jobs.description: Scale the bidding service that serves billions of ad requests a day. Go, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes. 6+ years of backend experience. Remote in the US.

jobs.title: Platform Developer (Python)
jobs.description:
Build internal data platform services in Python on AWS, with Kafka event streams. 5+ years of backend experience.

Hybrid: two days a week in our Denver office.
